caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a top hat. The hat has a tall, cylindrical crown and a wide, flat brim. The hat is decorated with horizontal stripes in light blue and red, accompanied by intricate patterns that include zigzag and wavy lines, also primarily in blue and red. The brim and the top surface of the crown feature additional detailing with blue and green leafy or floral motifs. The overall color palette consists of muted, pastel shades, with the background of the drawing being plain and beige. There appears to be a thin, dark string or cord partially encircling the hat near the base of the crown. The hat sits on a plain, undecorated surface, and the drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with the name "Gilbert Packerma[n]."
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
